description: 景觀道路類(第一階段)範圍圖 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 內政部國家公園署. 就「重要海岸景觀區」之「景觀道路類」之部分路段先予劃設範圍，即臺東縣省道台11線靠海側之濱海陸地（北起與花蓮縣交界處，南至卑南溪口）劃設為「重要海岸景觀區景觀道路類（第1階段）範圍」。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 內政部國家公園署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
